name: str_to_sentence
title: Convert string to upper case, lower case, title case, or sentence case

origin.description: Capitalize the first letter of each sentence and lower the rest.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: Input vector. Either a character vector, or something coercible to one.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale for case mapping. Defaults to "en" (English) so the result does not follow the machine locale.

origin.details: Sentence breaks come from the stringi break iterator with type sentence. The default locale is English.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as string.
origin.example:
print(str_to_sentence("the quick brown dog"))
print(str_to_sentence("a Test. a second."))
